model: oido_es.tnm (NVIDIA conformer-ctc-small fine-tuned for Spanish, int8, streaming-capable) + oido_es.tlm (GRU LM, weights 0.5 / token bonus 1.5, beam 4)

wer_full_test_sets.note: complete test sets: Common Voice 17 es (15,857 utts, 26.9 h), MLS es (2,385, 10.0 h), VoxPopuli es (1,528, 5.0 h), FLEURS es_419 (745 with digit-free references, 2.5 h)

wer_400_utterance_subsets.note: 400 evenly spaced utterances per set (333 for FLEURS after dropping references with digits), the subsets Whisper tiny was scored on

normalization: lowercase, accents kept (a e i o u with acute, u with diaeresis, n with tilde), punctuation removed; references containing digits are excluded; Whisper hypotheses have numerals spelled out (num2words)
lm_weights: 0.5 / 1.5 chosen from a small grid (0.3-0.7 x 0.5-2.0) on the 400-utterance test subsets; the optimum is flat (all of 0.4-0.6 with bonus 1.5-2.0 within 0.2 absolute mean WER)
training: phase 1: 25k steps, phase 2: 5k, final: 70k steps on 2,492 h (Common Voice es train + unvalidated clips kept when NVIDIA stt_es_conformer_ctc_large agrees within 15% WER, VoxPopuli es, MLS es, FLEURS es_419) with MUSAN noise/music/babble and simulated reverberation
